summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Wrote 15 spec-contract tests (OpenAPIClientGenerationContractTests) pinning the vendored openapi.json artifact, package wiring for swift-openapi-generator/runtime, all six API surfaces (operationIds, status codes, schemas, bearer scheme), and 6+1 canImport-guarded stubbed-transport tests (GeneratedClientStubbedTransportTests) exercising the generated Client against in-memory responses, with explicit red markers while the module is absent. Contract deltas and endpoint gaps (incl. undefined ranked_results schema, unspecified status codes, unmet upstream dependency viamin/color_matching#110 -> 404, no OpenAPI artifacts on upstream main) recorded in docs/openapi-client-test-plan.md. All issue ACs remain unimplemented by design in this phase; no Swift toolchain exists in this container (swift/xcrun absent) so swift test could not execute locally - CI (macos-latest) is the executor. Lint/test commands: none configured (echo no-ops).
